name: Quiet Shelter
summary: One grounded silhouette: a square minaret flows into a broad shelter, opened by a generous Islamic arch.
why: The minaret, roof and façade form one continuous mass. A pointed horseshoe doorway is carved through the lower edge, giving the architecture its identity without a dome or floating ornament. The brass cap shares the exact tower edges.
risk: The mosque identity is deliberately architectural and understated; it is less immediately literal than a dome-and-minaret illustration.
sub1: Tower and prayer hall share one solid foundation
sub2: A generous pointed horseshoe arch stays open at small sizes
reasonToChoose: A spare mosque identity that feels like a calm place to return to.
